newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks close down on Wall Street fall.
newsitem.headline: French stocks close down on Wall Street fall.

text.p: French shares fell in the afternoon on opening losses on Wall Street, consolidating after reaching a year high on Tuesday.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 9.76 points or 0.45 percent at 2,158.52 while the CAC-40 futures contract was down at 2,157 from 2,172 on Tuesday's close.

Alcatel Alsthom gained 2.43 percent to 455.70 francs on news it had now won the bidding for indebted and loss-making electronics group Thomson SA. On Tuesday afternoon, Alcatel fell 2.22 percent on rumours it had won.
Winner Lagardere Groupe was suspended for the day.
Lagardere said a planned merger between its Matra defence unit and Thomson-CSF would enhance earnings per growth.
Lagardere is planning a 156 francs-per-share buy-out bid for minorities in Thomson-CSF, which will cost a total of 7.8 billion francs. Thomson-CSF was also suspended on Wednesday.
Lagardere's Filipacchi Medias was up 2.61 percent at 1,099 on spinoff talk.
Total trading volume was 6.7 billion francs, of which 4.6 billion on blue-chip shares.
"The decline today was on profit-taking. But that could turn into a downward correction in the coming days," a dealer said.
